text: Now this is the commandment,{H4687} the statutes,{H2706} and the ordinances,{H4941} which Jehovah{H3068} your God{H430} commanded{H6680} to teach{H3925} you, that ye might do{H6213} them in the land{H776} whither ye go{H5674} over to possess{H3423} it;
